title: Fixed attribution from Portal route fragments
summary: Architecture: a page URL may have a query string and a Portal route fragment with its own campaign parameters. Problem: removing the Portal prefix from the whole URL fails when a page query is already present; attribution reads the wrong query. Solution: read the query directly from the Portal fragment. Fragment attribution remains authoritative for Portal routes.
validation: Proposed parser fix. Cover signup and signin, route slashes, query conflicts, precedence and a fragment without a query.
